purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for an Airawa imperial checkpoint witness-bloom fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for routine return processing, Oru's arrival, the witness bloom, ecological comparison, supervisor pressure, the final custody threshold, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for checkpoint establishment, roles, routine tools, returner arrival, the one-sentence bloom reveal, response choices, supervisor entry, final record threshold, and each ending family. The reveal remains a separate replay beat before the player acts.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt describes a complete visible frame with concrete alien anatomy, room geometry, materials, light, interfaces, and props. Prompt assembly adds only visible character refs plus triggered state or branch deltas.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: painterly speculative-biopunk noir storybook frame, restrained gouache and ink texture, low-energy bioluminescence, damp root-grown architecture, precise alien anatomy, readable ecological interfaces, muted mineral greens and bruised violet against amber fungal light, intimate bureaucratic tension, cinematic interactive-fiction composition.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every image from global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters and organisms whose visibility_condition is satisfied in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Keep visual_continuity_notes in tooling and use the authored scene_set coordinates for every camera.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture stays inside one twelve-body-length checkpoint hall and its two threshold routes. The authored plan fixes axes, zones, occlusion, entry paths, and camera slots for B-level replay continuity.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: For high-consistency final website art, lower this map into a hand-built plan view or simple 3D blockout before painterly image generation.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide arrivalward-to-doctrineward view of Sluice Nine, a narrow living checkpoint hall grown from dark braided roots. An outer arrival arch opens behind the camera-side end; an inner doctrine arch stands at the far end beneath a translucent pale supervisor membrane. A low oval rinse dais straddles a crosswise slotted floor drain at mid-hall. Amber candle-fungus beads glow through a grate on the arrival side of the drain; a thin silver-green prismwake mat borders the doctrine side; a recessed fleshy ceramic incinerator throat sits beside the far arch. Root ribs provide claw holds along both walls and the ceiling. One six-limbed Airawa groomer works at the dais: long digitigrade legs with paired grasping foot-talons, two large clawed upper arms, two smaller blunt four-digit lower hands, tiny soft scales, grown plate sections with faint luminous seams, practical gray-green apron and wrist wraps.

visible_characters.default_stance: braced at the rinse dais, one upper claw on a wall rib while both lower hands arrange tools

visual_continuity_notes: The hall long axis always runs from arrival arch through the central drain and dais to the doctrine arch.
The fungal grate stays arrivalward of the drain; the prismwake strip stays doctrineward of the drain; the incinerator remains beside the doctrine arch.

review_notes: Visual continuity self-review accepted the plan for B-level illustrated replay after adding conditional flower visibility, a branch-neutral silence frame, explicit state remnants, and modifiers for all material branches and endings.
Spatial cohesion self-review accepted the authored fixed-axis scene_set map after replacing a rotating-dais implication with a fixed quarantine marker and clarifying supervisor entry and limb reach.
The authored scene_set map is the geometry authority for this fixture; image generation remains deferred, and final high-consistency website art should begin from a hand-built plan or 3D blockout.
